packageRules.description: Hold mise-managed tool updates at least as long as mise's own `minimum_release_age` (default 24h). mise applies that cooldown when it resolves and locks versions, but installs of already-locked versions skip it, so an update Renovate locks sooner would bypass mise's protection entirely. Three days matches `security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm` and leaves margin for timestamp differences between Renovate's datasources and mise's own.
